description: This file contains a speed test module for measuring database read performance in an Odoo (OpenERP) environment, including classes for cursor counting and quality testing.

classes.name: CounterCursor
classes.description: A cursor wrapper that counts the number of SELECT queries executed.

classes.name: quality_test
classes.description: A class that performs a speed test to evaluate database read performance of modules.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a query and increments count if it's a SELECT.

methods.name: __getattr__
methods.description: Delegates attribute access to the underlying cursor.

methods.name: run_test
methods.description: Runs the speed test on a specified module, measuring database read performance.

methods.name: get_result
methods.description: Formats the speed test results into a table.

methods.name: get_result_details
methods.description: Generates detailed HTML report of the test results.
